name: Milestone plaque
oneLiner: a gallery spot clicks on and a framed brushed-metal award plaque swings round out of the dark: the medallion turns in, the engraved count rolls up to the milestone and stamps, a hard glint races across the metal and a star flares, its reflections sliding as it turns slowly under the light
say: when the speaker hits or mentions a milestone ('we just crossed 100,000', 'a million of you'): the count stamps and the glint flares on the number. silver below a million, gold from a million (metal: auto)
